purpose: Qualitative evidence for the generic_query retrieval method (Phase 1.5). Not a statistical evaluation.
method_V1: V0 + generic second query: RRF over BM25 and E5 rankings of the query and of generalize_query(query) (config/pipeline.yaml: generic_query: true)
rank: 1-based rank of the first gold lemma in the fused list (depth 100 per ranker); null = not in the fused list (beyond ~100)
selection_caveat: Probes chosen by hand (2 reported by the team, 5 typical olympiad lemmas: inequalities, divisibility, sums). The type variable `R` (vs `α`) was chosen looking at the first two probes, so this set is not held out.

diagnosis_unbounded_ranks.note: Rank of the gold lemma over the whole full index for the original query, each ranker alone (2026-10-19).
causes: BM25: the token ℝ (idf 2.56) adds 3-4.4 points to every Real.* lemma and 0 to generic lemmas
BM25 length normalisation: generic signatures carry many typeclass binders ([Semiring R] [LinearOrder R] ...), lowering the weight of matched symbols
Variable names differ (query x, lemma a) and Mathlib names (sq, nonneg, dvd) are not in the symbolic query
E5: the embedding of a query with ℝ lands among Real.* lemmas (Real.lt_sqrt, Real.rpow_nonneg, ...)

probes.query: (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) : a ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2
probes.generalized: (a b : R) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) : a ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2

probes.query: (a b c : ℤ) (h₁ : a ∣ b) (h₂ : b ∣ c) : a ∣ c
probes.generalized: (a b c : R) (h₁ : a ∣ b) (h₂ : b ∣ c) : a ∣ c

probes.query: (a b : ℤ) (n : ℕ) : a - b ∣ a ^ n - b ^ n
probes.generalized: (a b : R) (n : ℕ) : a - b ∣ a ^ n - b ^ n

probes.query: (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f i = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i + f n
probes.generalized: (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → R) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f i = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i + f n

limitations.sq_nonneg: Still outside the fused list with V1 (BM25 94, E5 200 for the generalised query). The query has no lexical overlap with the name (sq, nonneg) and uses x where the lemma uses a.
limitations.dvd_trans: Still outside the fused list with V1. The lemma states its hypotheses as implications (a ∣ b → b ∣ c → a ∣ c), the query as named binders (h₁ : a ∣ b), and its signature is short and generic, so neither ranker matches it.
limitations.future_work_V2: Appending Mathlib naming-convention words to the generalised query (0 ≤ → nonneg, ^ 2 → sq, ∣ → dvd, ...) put sq_nonneg at 16 and dvd_trans at 43 in an exploratory run, but lowered Q-dev R@16 (0.627 vs 0.634; 1 win / 2 losses) and its rules were written after seeing these probes. Not adopted.
